sentences.text: The present petition seeks quashing of FIR No. 390/2024 registered at Police Station Jafrabad for the offences under Sections 498A/406/506/377/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860,1 and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 as well as all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom.
The request is made in light of the Memorandum of Understanding/Settlement Agreement dated 13th December 2024.

2. Counsel for parties seek time to file additional affidavits in support of "IPC"
